question.problem: Represent the solution of the inequality $k -12 \lt  -5$ on a number line.
question.worked_solution:
To isolate $k,$ we need to perform the *opposite* of *subtracting* $12,$ which is *adding* $12.$
Remember to perform the same operation on the right-hand side.

$$
\begin{aligned}k-12 & <-5 \\ k-12+12 & <-5+12 \\ k+0 & <7 \\ k & <7\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution is $k \lt  7.$ The solution can be expressed on a number line, as shown below.
